title: MIDAS RIN List Response (v2.0)
description: Response from the ValueData endpoint when queried with SignalType alone. v2.0 (2026-06-22) replaces the v1.0 bare array of RinListEntry with a single-keyed object. On the live v2.0 API the wrapper key is ALWAYS 'Rates', regardless of the requested SignalType (confirmed 2026-06-22 for SignalType 0/1/2/3 — the 'GHGEmissions', 'FlexAlerts', and 'All' keys implied by early design notes do not appear on the wire). Consumers should peel the single value without switching on the key name; the per-entry SignalType field identifies each RIN's signal type. SignalType=0 returns all active RINs (replacing the removed HistoricalList endpoint), still under the 'Rates' key.

Rates.description: The RIN entries for the requested SignalType. Always the 'Rates' key on live v2.0, whatever the SignalType.
